name: Modbus Client → Write Single Register
description: Writes a single holding register (function code `0x06`).

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The Modbus device address the frame is sent to. Accepts `0`-`255`; the valid Modbus device range is `1`-`247`, and `0` is broadcast (never answered unless `allow_broadcast_read` or `expect_broadcast_write_response` is set; see [Behavior](https://esphome.io/components/modbus_client/#behavior)).

config_entries.label: Modbus ID
config_entries.description: The Modbus hub to send on. Automatically assigned when a single hub is configured.

config_entries.label: Start Address
config_entries.description: The starting register or coil address. Not used by `read_write_multiple_registers`, which takes separate `read_address` and `write_address` instead. `start_address + count` (or `+ values.size()` for a write) must not exceed `0x10000`; a literal value is rejected at config time, but a templated one bypasses that check and fails at runtime - an out-of-range address produces an empty PDU, and `on_not_sent` fires instead of the send. The same holds for the per-action `count` and `values` bounds below: a lambda returning a count or list length outside its documented range also produces an empty PDU and fires `on_not_sent`.

config_entries.label: Expect Broadcast Write Response
config_entries.description: Wait for the reply to this write when it is sent to address `0`, instead of treating it as fire-and-forget - see [Broadcast](https://esphome.io/components/modbus_client/#behavior) under Behavior. Accepted by the four write actions only. Defaults to `false`.
